```{r}
#|echo: false
#|warning: false

# read in required packages
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(forcats)
library(scales)
library(ggsci)

mat_neo_data <- read_excel(here("data/MatNeoSIP.xlsx"), sheet = "Data") |>
  clean_names() |>
  rename(
    "stage_7_all" = "stage_7",
    "quarter" = "date"
  ) |>
  rename_with(~ str_replace(., "x", "stage_"), starts_with("x"))
```

```{r}
# functions

# 1 aggregate by psc and intervention stage
aggregate_int <- function(df, my_filter, intervention) {
  # to quote variable
  intervention <- enquo(intervention)

  df |>
    filter(!!my_filter) |>
    group_by(
      psc,
      !!intervention
    ) |>
    summarise(n = n()) |>
    ungroup() |>
    group_by(psc) |>
    mutate(
      total = sum(n),
      percentage = n / total
    ) |>
    ungroup()
}

# 2 aggregate by quarter and calculate how many NHS orgs are reporting at stage 5 or above for a given intervention
aggregate_stage <- function(df, intervention) {
  # to quote variable
  intervention <- enquo(intervention)

  # to quote intervention name
  intervention_string <- deparse(intervention)

  intervention_name <- intervention_string |>
    str_remove("~") |> # 1 remove ~ added by deparse
    str_replace_all("_", " ") |> # 2 replace _ with blank space
    str_to_title() # 3 capitalise clean string into title

  df |>
    select(psc:quarter, !!intervention) |>
    mutate(
      stage_5_or_above = str_count(!!intervention, "Stage (5|6|7)"),
      stage_5_all = if_else(stage_5_or_above >= 1, 1, 0)
    ) |>
    summarise(
      s5_all = sum(stage_5_all, na.rm = T),
      all_reporters = n(),
      percentage = (s5_all / all_reporters),
      .by = quarter
    ) |>
    mutate(
      intervention = intervention_name,
      .after = quarter
    )
}

# 3 make graph
visualise_bars <- function(df, intervention,
                           intervention_name = NULL,
                           # most plots will have psc in their x axis, but some will need quarter instead
                           aes_x = expr(psc),
                           # mopst plots will use the title below, except the quarter charts
                           plot_title = "Adoption of optimisation interventions across PCS's as a share of implementation stages",
                           plot_caption = glue::glue("Data reported by the PSC's for {report_quarter}")) {
  # to quote variable
  intervention <- enquo(intervention)

  # this is to set the subtitle string
  if (is.null(intervention_name)) {
    intervention_string <- deparse(intervention)

    intervention_subtitle <- intervention_string |>
      str_remove("~") |> # 1 remove ~ added by deparse
      str_replace_all("_", " ") |> # 2 replace _ with blank space
      str_to_title() # 3 capitalise clean string into title
  } else {
    intervention_subtitle <- intervention_name
  }

  # custom palette of blues in reversed order
  blues <- rev(scales::brewer_pal()(7))
  text_colour <- c(rep("white", 3), rep("black", 4))

  # blues <- scales::brewer_pal()(7)
  # text_colour <- c(rep("black", 4), rep("white", 3))

  df |>
    ggplot(aes(
      x = forcats::fct_rev(!!aes_x), # reverse alphabetical order
      y = percentage,
      fill = forcats::fct_rev(!!intervention) # reverse stage order
    )) +
    geom_bar(
      stat = "identity",
      position = "stack",
      size = 11
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = blues,
      na.value = "#808080",
      # below makes levels of factor appear in increasing order in legend (stage 1-7)
      guide = guide_legend(reverse = T)
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = text_colour, na.value = "white") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.025, 0.025)) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = scales::percent(percentage, accuracy = 1), # 1 means round to the nearest unit of 1, so 73.3 is rounded as 73 and no decimal places show on graph
        colour = forcats::fct_rev(!!intervention) # reverse again so position argument is obeyed
      ),
      position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    ) +
    guides(
      colour = guide_none() # removes 'a' text from boxes in legend
    ) +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      subtitle = intervention_subtitle,
      caption = plot_caption
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.justification = "left",
      plot.caption = element_text(
        face = "italic",
        size = 10,
        hjust = 0 # so caption is on right hand side
      )
    )
}

# 4 visualise line plots
visualise_line <- function(df, aes_group, aes_colour,
                           hline_colour, annotate_x, annotate_y, subtitle_string) {
  ggplot(
    data = df,
    aes(quarter,
      percentage,
      group = !!aes_group,
      colour = !!aes_colour
    )
  ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0.65,
      linetype = "dashed",
      colour = hline_colour
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::percent_format(),
      limits = c(0, 1)
    ) +
    annotate(
      geom = "text",
      x = annotate_x,
      y = annotate_y,
      label = "Target for 2022/23 Q4 (i.e., 65%)"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Adoption of optimisation interventions across NHS Trusts",
      subtitle = subtitle_string,
      caption = glue::glue("Data reported by the PSC's for {report_quarter}")
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(),
      plot.caption = element_text(
        face = "italic",
        size = 10,
        hjust = 0 # so caption is on right hand side
      ),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.justification = "left"
    )
}

report_quarter <- params$report_quarter
```

```{r}
mat_neo_long <- mat_neo_data |>
  filter(quarter == report_quarter) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = magnesium_sulphate:mews,
    names_to = "intervention",
    values_to = "stage"
  )

aggregate_int(
  mat_neo_long,
  my_filter = expr(!intervention %in% c(
    "mews", "newtt2", # excluded because they're not optimisation interventions
    "volume_targeted_ventilation", # why has this been excluded?
    "caffeine" # ditto
  )),
  stage
) |>
  visualise_bars(
    stage,
    "All optimisation interventions (Excl. caffeine and volume targeted ventilation)"
  )
```

```{r}
mat_neo_agg_stage_provider <- mat_neo_data |>
  select(psc:volume_targeted_ventilation) |>
  mutate(
    all_stages = paste(magnesium_sulphate,
      corticosteroids,
      antibiotics,
      optimal_cord_management,
      normothermia,
      maternal_breast_milk,
      place_of_birth,
      # caffeine, #not included why?
      # volume_targeted_ventilation, #ditto
      sep = " / "
    ), # will paste NA as string 'NA' and this is intentional for counts
    stage_5_or_above = str_count(all_stages, "Stage (5|6|7)"),
    stage_5_all = if_else(stage_5_or_above >= 7, 1, 0)
  ) |>
  select(-all_stages)

mat_neo_stage_all <- mat_neo_agg_stage_provider |>
  group_by(quarter) |>
  summarise(
    s5_all = sum(stage_5_all),
    all_reporters = n(),
    percentage = (s5_all / all_reporters)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

visualise_line(
  df = mat_neo_stage_all,
  aes_group = expr(1),
  aes_colour = expr(NULL),
  hline_colour = "navy",
  annotate_x = "2021/22 Q3",
  annotate_y = 0.70,
  subtitle_string = "Percentage of organisations reporting all implementation stages at level 5 or above\n(Excl. caffeine and volume targeted ventilation)"
) +
  geom_line(colour = "#660066") +
  geom_point(
    colour = "#660066",
    size = 2
  )
```

```{r}
spaghetti_data <- bind_rows(
  aggregate_stage(mat_neo_data, magnesium_sulphate),
  aggregate_stage(mat_neo_data, corticosteroids),
  aggregate_stage(mat_neo_data, antibiotics),
  aggregate_stage(mat_neo_data, optimal_cord_management),
  aggregate_stage(mat_neo_data, normothermia),
  aggregate_stage(mat_neo_data, maternal_breast_milk),
  aggregate_stage(mat_neo_data, place_of_birth)
  # aggregate_stage(mat_neo_data, caffeine), #not included in orignal chart, why?
  # aggregate_stage(mat_neo_data, volume_targeted_ventilation) #ditto
)

visualise_line(
  df = spaghetti_data,
  aes_group = expr(intervention),
  aes_colour = expr(intervention),
  hline_colour = "black",
  annotate_x = "2023/24 Q3",
  annotate_y = 0.60,
  subtitle_string = "Percentage of organisations reporting all implementation stages at level 5 or above"
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  ggsci::scale_colour_jco()
```

```{r}
mat_neo_agg_newtt2_quarter <- mat_neo_data |>
  select(quarter, organisation, newtt2) |>
  filter(
    newtt2 != "N/A", # had to use this for 2022/23 Q4 - Four orgs had this value
    !is.na(newtt2) # not a fan of this filter because it makes denominators smaller than in other bar charts
  ) |>
  group_by(quarter, newtt2) |>
  summarise(n = n()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(quarter) |>
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    percentage = (n / total)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# why do we have a plot by quarter only for NEWTT2 and MEWS
visualise_bars(
  df = mat_neo_agg_newtt2_quarter,
  intervention = newtt2,
  intervention_name = "Share of implementation stages across organisations reporting at stage 1 or above\n(Note: Denominators change between quarters)",
  aes_x = expr(quarter),
  plot_title = "Adoption of NEWTT2 across NHS organisations",
  plot_caption = element_blank()
)
```
